title: Advanced Biotechnology Ramifications & Research Thrusts
description: Frontier domains transforming life sciences research, therapeutic development, industrial bioprocessing, and computational biology across India.

domains.name: Genome Editing & Gene Therapy
domains.tagline: Precision targeted manipulation of nucleotide sequences in living organisms
domains.overview: Beyond traditional recombinant DNA, precise site-directed alteration using programmable nucleases enables functional genomics, clinical gene therapies, and climate-resilient crop breeding.

domains.name: Genomics & Next-Gen Sequencing
domains.tagline: High-throughput mapping, sequencing, and structural analysis of whole genomes
domains.overview: Decoding organismal blueprint through short-read and long-read sequencers to resolve complex variation, population genetics, rare disease diagnostics, and evolutionary biology.

domains.name: Transcriptomics & Single-Cell RNA
domains.tagline: Dynamic quantification and characterization of RNA expression at cellular resolution
domains.overview: Reveals which genes are turned on or off under physiological or disease conditions, including non-coding RNAs, alternative splicing, and spatial tissue microenvironments.

domains.name: Proteomics & Structural Biology
domains.tagline: Large-scale study of protein structure, function, post-translational modifications, and complexes
domains.overview: Proteins execute cellular functions. Modern proteomics measures abundance, phosphorylation/ubiquitination, interactomes, and atomic-resolution structures.
applications: Biomarker discovery for early disease detection

domains.name: Metabolomics & Metabolic Profiling
domains.tagline: Comprehensive profiling of low-molecular-weight metabolites in biofluids and tissues
domains.overview: Metabolomics captures the physiological endpoint closest to the phenotype, bridging genomics, dietary environmental influences, and disease pathophysiology.

domains.name: Systems Biology & Synthetic Biology
domains.tagline: Mathematical modeling of complex biological networks and de novo biological circuit engineering
domains.overview: Shifts biology from descriptive observation to predictive engineering. Combines computational modeling of biological networks with standardized genetic chassis design.
applications: Microbial cell factories for biofuels & bioplastics

domains.name: Bioinformatics & Computational Biology
domains.tagline: Algorithmic data science, molecular dynamics, and AI foundation models in life sciences
domains.overview: The computational backbone underpinning all omics disciplines. Encompasses pipeline engineering, machine learning for sequence prediction, and molecular simulations.
